engagements_insert_coach.name: engagements_insert_coach
engagements_insert_coach.withCheck: (select private.app_role()) = 'coach' and "app"."engagements"."coach_id" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."engagements"."org_id" = (select private.app_org_id()) and "app"."engagements"."stage" = 'alta' and not "app"."engagements"."diagnostico_verificado" and exists (select 1 from app.users u where u.id = "app"."engagements"."persona_id" and u.role = 'persona' and u.org_id = (select private.app_org_id()))

engagements_verificacion_completa.name: engagements_verificacion_completa
engagements_verificacion_completa.value: not "app"."engagements"."diagnostico_verificado" or ("app"."engagements"."cedula_profesional" is not null and "app"."engagements"."diagnostico_verificado_por" is not null and "app"."engagements"."diagnostico_verificado_en" is not null)

fe_corrections_sin_dominio.name: fe_corrections_sin_dominio
fe_corrections_sin_dominio.value: "app"."fe_corrections"."dominio" is not null or "app"."fe_corrections"."direccion" is null

fe_domain_summaries_insert_coach.name: fe_domain_summaries_insert_coach
fe_domain_summaries_insert_coach.withCheck: (select private.app_is_coach_of("app"."fe_domain_summaries"."engagement_id")) and (select private.app_has_consent("app"."fe_domain_summaries"."engagement_id")) and "app"."fe_domain_summaries"."created_by" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."fe_domain_summaries"."estado" = 'propuesto' and "app"."fe_domain_summaries"."decided_by" is null

followup_context_insert_coach.name: followup_context_insert_coach
followup_context_insert_coach.withCheck: (select private.app_is_coach_of("app"."followup_context"."engagement_id")) and "app"."followup_context"."approved_by" = (select auth.uid()) and (select private.app_has_consent("app"."followup_context"."engagement_id")) and "app"."followup_context"."quitada_por" is null and "app"."followup_context"."quitada_en" is null and (select private.app_evento_de_sesion("app"."followup_context"."event_id", "app"."followup_context"."session_id", "app"."followup_context"."engagement_id")) and ("app"."followup_context"."plan_item_id" is null or (select private.app_item_del_acompanamiento("app"."followup_context"."plan_item_id", "app"."followup_context"."engagement_id")))

invitations_insert_coach.name: invitations_insert_coach
invitations_insert_coach.withCheck: (select private.app_is_coach_of("app"."invitations"."engagement_id")) and "app"."invitations"."creada_por" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."invitations"."expira_en" > now() and "app"."invitations"."persona_id" = (select e.persona_id from app.engagements e where e.id = "app"."invitations"."engagement_id") and not (select private.app_invitacion_usada("app"."invitations"."engagement_id"))

invitations_update_coach.name: invitations_update_coach
invitations_update_coach.using: (select private.app_is_coach_of("app"."invitations"."engagement_id")) and "app"."invitations"."usada_en" is null and "app"."invitations"."reemplazada_en" is null

invitations_update_persona.name: invitations_update_persona
invitations_update_persona.using: "app"."invitations"."persona_id" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."invitations"."usada_en" is null and "app"."invitations"."reemplazada_en" is null and "app"."invitations"."expira_en" > now()

plans_insert_coach.name: plans_insert_coach
plans_insert_coach.withCheck: (select private.app_is_coach_of("app"."plans"."engagement_id")) and "app"."plans"."created_by" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."plans"."status" = 'borrador' and "app"."plans"."version" is null and (select private.app_has_consent("app"."plans"."engagement_id"))

profile_events_insert_persona_feedback.name: profile_events_insert_persona_feedback
profile_events_insert_persona_feedback.withCheck: (select private.app_is_persona_of("app"."profile_events"."engagement_id")) and "app"."profile_events"."created_by" = (select auth.uid()) and "app"."profile_events"."tipo" = 'no_me_representa' and "app"."profile_events"."status" = 'proposed' and (select private.app_has_consent("app"."profile_events"."engagement_id")) and "app"."profile_events"."session_id" is null and "app"."profile_events"."approved_payload" is null and "app"."profile_events"."decided_by" is null and "app"."profile_events"."decided_at" is null and "app"."profile_events"."prompt_version" is null and "app"."profile_events"."model" is null and "app"."profile_events"."perfil_version_base" is null and "app"."profile_events"."plan_base_id" is null and "app"."profile_events"."resuelto_por_evento" is null and "app"."profile_events"."resuelto_por_plan" is null and "app"."profile_events"."created_at" = now()
